# Corrections applied by dev/update_licenses.sh to what go-licenses reports.
# Automatic classification reads one license file and returns one SPDX id, which
# is wrong for the handful of modules that ship a compound license file or park
# a license somewhere unexpected. Fix those here rather than by editing the
# generated section of LICENSE-binary, which is overwritten on every run.
# Tab-separated:
#   <key>
# <key> is the module path for a module's own license file, or the module path
# joined with the directory the license governs for a nested one -- either way
# it reads like an import path. SKIP drops the entry from the inventory.
github.com/klauspost/compress
column3: LICENSE is BSD-3-Clause (for the Go-derived code) with the Apache-2.0 text appended; go-licenses only sees the Apache-2.0 half. The BSD-3-Clause grant is the one that has to be reproduced.
